fusions.name: Razor Strands
fusions.desc: A weapon strike threaded with razor strands of air that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tangling Gale
fusions.desc: Whips a tangle of strands on the wind around every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage, stripping 12% armour for 6 seconds and slowing each by 25%. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds, and your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Woven Shelter
fusions.desc: Weaves a barrier of streaming strands that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Finer Than Mail
fusions.desc: Your slashing attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour.
